title: 旷野青春 | 隐形防线（英文字幕版）
summary: A Chinese state-TV-produced documentary segment, with English subtitles, about virus sample collection in the field, including scientists collecting live bats. It was published in December 2019.
why: Cited in COVID origin debates as footage showing Wuhan CDC scientists handling live bats and bat coronaviruses.

quote.text: You can see him doing his work, including live bat collections, in this (government produced) documentary about the Wuhan CDC
